name: Satou Mika
source:
A sociable, lively girl who transfer into the school not long after the protagonist.
She bears an uncanny resemblance to [url=/c42967]Yajima Shinobu[/url], but contrary to her she is the owner of an upright personality who despises bullying and openly defends Yuuri.

She actively approaches the protagonist, feeling a certain sympathy toward him.
